name: ipv4-mapped-ipv6-rejected-from-v4-permit-invalid
description: An IPv4-mapped IPv6 SAN (::ffff:10.0.0.1) must not satisfy an IPv4-only permitted IP subtree. RFC 5280 4.2.1.10 treats iPAddress as a single GeneralName form, and address families cannot cross-apply.
notes: Botan considers this leaf invalid: an IPv6 SAN, even one whose value happens to be a mapped IPv4, does not satisfy an IPv4 iPAddress constraint.
